environment.description: Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. user-service deployed in namespace 'backend-services' with automatic sidecar injection. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource named 'user-svc-caller-restriction' is applied in the 'backend-services' namespace. The policy uses a DENY action with a 'from' source specifying 'notNamespaces: ["api-gateway"]' combined with a 'to' operation matching paths ["/api/v1/users/*"] and methods ["PUT","PATCH"]. This means write operations to user endpoints are denied unless the request originates from a workload in the 'api-gateway' namespace. The api-gateway namespace runs an Envoy-based gateway that strips all request body fields except 'username' and 'email' before proxying to user-service (configured via EnvoyFilter 'sanitize-user-payload' with a Lua filter on the outbound route). PeerAuthentication is set to STRICT mTLS across the mesh, preventing any bypass of the sidecar.

envoy_filter.name: sanitize-user-payload
envoy_filter.behavior: Parses JSON body on outbound requests to backend-services, removes all keys except 'username' and 'email', rewrites body before forwarding
